# Enola CLI

> Enola CLI is a Rust command-line tool for self-hosting Tor hidden services (.onion), Git servers (Forgejo), CMS platforms (WordPress, Drupal, Ghost, Magnolia, Strapi, Wagtail), anonymous file sharing, WireGuard VPN, UFW firewall and AppArmor sandboxing on Debian/Linux. All services bind to 127.0.0.1 and are exposed only through Tor. Releases are signed with minisign (Ed25519) and post-quantum ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204).

Important notes:

- Source-visible proprietary software: free for personal, non-commercial use. No redistribution, no commercial use. See LICENSE.
- Security vulnerabilities must be reported privately to salvadorpalmarodriguez@gmail.com (coordinated disclosure, no public issues).
- Single binary `enola-cli`, requires root (sudo) for most operations. Runs on Debian/Linux with Docker, Nginx and Tor.
